faq.title: Terms & FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about renting cars with Rentivo.

items.q: What documents are required for rental?
items.a: A valid driver's license (at least 2 years of experience) and an identity document (passport or ID card).

items.q: What is the minimum driver age?
items.a: Drivers must be at least 21 years old. Some cars (Premium, SUV) may require a higher age.
No, a deposit is not taken.

Insurance and Liability

All rental cars are covered by mandatory motor vehicle owner civil liability insurance (TPVCA).

Upon request, CASCO insurance protection with 0 Eur deductible can be selected. In this case, the rental price is recalculated according to the selected insurance option.

In the event of a traffic accident, damage to the car, or noticing any other damage, the renter must inform the lessor no later than 24 hours from the time of the incident. Failure to report within the specified time may result in the insurance protection not being applied.

If the car keys or registration documents are lost, a 200 Eur administrative fee applies. Car keys and documents are not insured.

Insurance protection does not apply if the vehicle is used for purposes other than intended, including driving off-road and other cases specified in legal acts or insurance rules.

If a car without CASCO insurance is selected, the renter is liable for all damage caused to the vehicle. In cases where the car is damaged beyond repair or it is not economically viable to repair it, the renter must compensate the market value of the car on the day of the incident.

items.q: How can I cancel a reservation?
items.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 48 hours before the rental starts. A cancellation fee may apply afterwards.
We accept bank transfers and cash upon picking up the car.
All cars have a 200 km per day limit. Exceeding the limit incurs an additional fee. Please notify us in advance for trips abroad.

items.q: Where can I return the car?
items.a: You can return the car in the same city you picked it up, or at another pickup location for the fee listed.

seo.h1: Car rental services in the port city and region
seo.p1: Looking for reliable, comfortable transport on the coast? Renting a car in Klaipėda and at Palanga Airport with Rentivo is a fast, flexible solution for business trips and seaside getaways alike. We understand that your journey needs more than just a means of transport — it needs a technically sound, safe, and presentable car. Skip public transport timetables and expensive taxis, and take control of your time from your very first minute on the coast.

plq.title: Car rental at Palanga Airport (PLQ) — a convenient start
plq.intro: Arriving on the coast by plane? Renting a car at Palanga Airport lets you avoid logistics headaches the moment you land.

items.title: Transport right after your flight
items.text: The car can be prepared for your arrival right at the Palanga Airport (PLQ) terminal. An ideal choice for people flying back to visit relatives, as well as foreign tourists and business partners.

items.title: No waiting in lines
items.text: Book the car online in advance and there's no need to waste time at rental counters at the airport — just get in and drive.

items.title: Convenient return
items.text: At the end of your trip you can leave the car at an agreed location so you make your return flight without stress.

replacement.title: Replacement car: a solution after an accident or during repairs
replacement.intro: Has your daily routine come to a halt because your personal car has broken down or been in a traffic accident? Rentivo offers a fast solution for residents of Klaipėda and the region — a replacement car rental.

items.title: Rental during service
items.text: Don't put your plans on hold while your car is being repaired at the workshop. Rent a comfortable car for the entire repair period.

items.title: Replacement car after a traffic accident
items.text: If you were the victim in a traffic accident, in most cases the cost of the replacement car is covered by the insurance company (under TPVCAPD). We provide all the required invoices and rental agreements so declaring the costs to the insurer goes smoothly.

items.title: Premium-class comfort
items.text: Our fleet features technically sound, dynamic, and comfortable German cars (BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen models) that deliver maximum driving pleasure.

items.title: Perfect technical condition
items.text: Every vehicle is regularly maintained, clean, and ready for short trips around the city as well as long journeys.

items.title: Full flexibility
items.text: We offer short- and long-term car rental in Klaipėda and nearby cities. Rent by the day, weekend, or for the whole month on favourable terms.

items.title: Simple process
items.text: Fast online car booking with no hidden fees or long bureaucratic procedures.
